summary: Prepare daemon, CLI, client and TUI directory readers for the staged Fractal config, state and instance-root migration

replay.detail: No stored history or replay change.

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change.

compatibility.detail: Daemon, CLI, client endpoint/device-profile discovery and TUI readers share one resolver. A destination-local .fractal-migration-completed receipt containing the exact migration ID and newline is required to select fractal config/state directories or .fractal-instance/NAME roots, even when the old directory is absent. Otherwise the old path wins, with one warning per process if an unreceipted destination exists. Creators use the same selected root as readers, including when creating a missing config file. XDG overrides, explicit config/state paths and instance-name precedence remain intact. Instance workspaces retain their legacy locations. The st3-kernel and st3-telemetry dependencies on st3-client are deliberate R11 bridge edges: only st3_client::product_dirs is allowed, because the standalone client owns the single receipt resolver. The module-layer check enforces this namespace boundary; both edges and the resolver are removed at contraction of arn:lmig:smalltalk:2026-10-16-state-dirs-fractal. External installers, operational scripts and Home Manager remain outside this expansion; no live move is authorized.

downtime.detail: Reader expansion only: no files moved and no daemon or service restart performed.

manual.detail: Do not move live state or author completion receipts as part of this release. The per-site live migration is separate.

recovery.detail: Existing installations without new directories resolve the same paths as before.
